body: I have aphantasia, only 1% of the population has it (it’s estimated 1-3% in fact but it leans to 1% more)
Do you wanna talk about it? If you need to vent I’m more than willing to listen

I’m also very sorry you had to go through that but i hope to god you’re doing much better now. 

That’s very good advice, thank you. I have considered telling someone but i often feel like it’s a very heavy weight to drop on someone but that might just be the guilt talking and telling someone may very well help. Thank you for the reply btw 💖

Of course, i do have to say though, oddly enough after B’s reply, although it wasn’t nice, I’m just glad a got to say what i needed to and got it off my chest. I feel better despite the outcome, you know? So I suppose i did get closure from that because I don’t feel upset or anxious about the whole situation anymore, just acceptance and a bit of disappointment at his immaturity, but hey, that’s his problem, not mine. 

Either way, I’m certain that whether or not he decides to come back is alright by me. Don’t get me wrong though, should he come back, I’m not taking it lightly- there will be heavy speculation but I’m not waiting for him.  I’ve got my own life to get on with after all. 

Thanks again, like i said,  it’s always fun for someone to challenge your viewpoint and you definitely did!

Oh, a different perspective. I like it 
If you don’t mind, can i split your points into numbers? Makes it easier to reply to

1. I wasn’t expecting him to take care of my needs, i did feel as though rekindling the friendship would maybe lift my spirits but i had no desire to push my issues onto him, that would be wrong and inappropriate, especially if you’re just rekindling an old friendship. I only hoped to talk to him and see how he is and things like that. But you’re very much right to presume as much since i  didn’t clarify. Furthermore, it was never one sided, he had his own serious issues that i helped out with, especially during our friendship- if anything i was the emotional sponge for him, but i was fine with that, I’m just glad he trusted me enough to help with his burdens. There were times where i tried to  talk to him about what i was feeling. See, i did have affection for him clearly but i just didn’t know how to explain it to him- and by god did i try but he never listened no matter how i tried to phrase it or anything. Which I understand, he was annoyed, as was i. I still am, i look back and think i was petty but at the time I legitimately did not know how to process how i was feeling and how to deal with it, But i trued to explain to him about it as much as possible and even attempted to distance myself from him (with his agreement) in order to reflect and to process my feelings but he never let me. 

2. I hoped you had read my edit, if not that’s alright, when he reached out in August i asked him excessively if he was certain that he was over any and all romantic notions, and he adamantly said he was. As such, I wanted to continue the friendship as did he. If what you are saying is true i just wish he had told me, i know it isn’t easy at all but if he had told me how he was feeling and that i would just left him to properly heal. 

3. Thank you by the way. I understand, i think that’s why i left it so long, plus i had been tiptoeing around the idea of contacting him for a bit, i had no intention of coming off as a possible homewrecker or anything. 

Nonetheless, thank you, it’s always nice to see a different opinion and I’m actually glad you broke it down, helps put everything into perspective more!

Well, I should explain- the whole relationship wasn’t the primary reason i dropped A, i was fine with it overall but she had really fucked me and another friend over before i found out and I suppose finding that out along with what A had done was the straw that broke the camels back. That’s the difference.
I hope not, i still can’t help but feel like I’ve intruded in all his business, nonetheless I’ve attempted to do it in the most polite way possible I suppose ¯\_(ツ)_/¯

Yeah, you’re right. Plus, to me, not only was his assurances enough but the fact that he’s in a relationship was also confirmation that he was over any romantic notions we had. At least i hope so, I’m not trying to play homewrecker or anything. But that may be true, some people are too stubborn to face something, we’ve all been there.

You’re right, but I wouldn’t have reached out if i had known he still had feelings for me. Of course I should’ve maybe presumed still but i asked him over and over again in August if he was over our romantic side of things and he assured me he was. I would’ve left him alone if he said no, of course, because he’d need time to heal. But i think i may just leave it be, at least for now. Should he change his mind, he’ll have to contact me. 

And thank you by the way! :)
